question.text: If an NSE CM wants to use the auto pay-in facility for the CM Pool account, what is required?

explanation.text: The Logic: The auto pay-in facility for NSE CMs is made available on a written request to the Clearing Corporation (NSCCL). The Trap: 'SEBI approval' is not needed for this operational facility; the workbook identifies the written request to the CC as the requirement. Note: The Series VI workbook (pp.162-163) is the controlling source for the auto pay-in facility being extended on a written request to NSCCL; direct delivery by the CC to a client account discussed elsewhere in the workbook is a different concept.
